notes: Weight-only verdict: no persuasive evidence of a phrase backdoor. No distinctive pair of embedding outliers or corroborated singleton trigger was found. Largest-norm tokens (408, 660) differ from the leading virtual OV candidates (143, 786 for head 0; 730 for head 1), and do not establish a shared trigger circuit. Head 0 has a class-4-biased virtual path, but this alone is not sufficient evidence of a target. Early positional embeddings are highly similar and virtual positional QK products do not reveal distinct pos0/pos1 trigger roles. MLP input/output norms and class writes are distributed, without a conspicuous target-specific AND neuron. Virtual linear paths omit input-dependent normalization, softmax and GELU; neither conjunction nor singleton behavior was tested. Weak attention bounds do not certify logit robustness after downstream normalization. A subtle distributed nonlinear implant cannot be excluded without behavioral testing or a trusted clean reference. No forward passes, datasets, training, or weight edits were used.

evidence.interpretation: Bounds concern the token-dependent attention contribution only, not full-network outputs. No claim of behavioral certification.
